s1_hook.text: Meet Check-iN. Peace of mind for families, in just three taps a day.

s2_checkin.text: At seven A M, noon, and seven P M — tap the heart. Your family instantly knows you're safe.

s3_meds_sos.text: Never miss a medication. And in an emergency, one tap alerts everyone who cares.

s4_ring.text: Guardians see the full picture — vitals, mood, adherence — at a glance.

s5_alerts.text: If a check-in is missed, or your loved one leaves their safe zone, we alert you instantly on WhatsApp.

s6_safety.text: Fall detection, journey tracking, and a secure health vault — all working quietly in the background.

s7_grid.text: Plus medications, vitals, first aid, blood banks, and a voice assistant that's always listening.

s8_outro.text: Check-iN. Because caring should be simple.
